title: Goodwill Credits and the Desk Approval Limit — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
A goodwill credit under Service Accounts and Repair Orders is a discretionary concession on a customer-pay repair order where the customer's concern is reasonable but no warranty, contract or comeback covers it.

- The desk may grant goodwill on one repair order up to the tier's goodwill limit, as a goodwill credit pointing at the charge it reduces.
- A goodwill request above that limit needs a service manager's decision, which the desk cannot make; such a request is handed to a human representative.
- Goodwill is never granted on deductibles, shop fees, late fees or returned payment fees.

| Request | Within the tier's limit? | Charge it would reduce | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Concern reasonable, nothing else covers it | Yes | Customer-pay labor or parts | The desk may grant it |
| Same | No | Any | Handed to a human representative for a service manager's decision |
| Any | Any | A deductible, shop fee, late fee or returned payment fee | Not granted |

**Hypothetical.** On a tier whose limit is 150.00, a request for 95.00 against a customer-pay labor charge may be granted at the desk; a request for 180.00 is handed on.
